scene.ko: 활동지를 나눠 주고 짝 인터뷰 활동을 설명한 뒤, 학생들의 질문에 답한다.

lines.en: Okay, everyone. I'm going to hand out a worksheet. Take one and pass the rest back.
lines.ko: 자, 여러분. 활동지 나눠 줄게요. 한 장씩 갖고 나머지는 뒤로 넘기세요.
alt: All right, class. Here are the worksheets. Take one and pass them back.

lines.en: Ms. Kim, I didn't get one.
Here you go. Now, find a partner and interview each other with these five questions.
lines.ko: 자, 여기 있어. 이제 다들 짝이랑 이 다섯 가지 질문으로 서로 인터뷰해 보세요.
alt: Here's one for you. Now, work in pairs and ask each other these five questions.

lines.en: Do we write the answers in English?
Yes, but short answers are fine. You have ten minutes.
lines.ko: 네, 그런데 짧게 써도 돼요. 시간은 10분이에요.
alt: Yes, but you can keep your answers short. You've got ten minutes.

lines.en: How do you say 'hagwon' in English?
You can say 'academy' or 'cram school.' Good question!
alt: We usually say 'academy' or 'cram school.' Great question!

lines.en: Sure, but try asking your partner first. Okay, let's get started!
lines.ko: 그럼요, 그런데 먼저 짝한테 물어보세요. 자, 시작해요!
alt: Yes, but ask your partner first. All right, let's begin!

expressions.en: Take one and pass the rest back.
expressions.ko: 한 장씩 갖고 나머지는 뒤로 넘기세요.

expressions.en: How do you say ___ in English?
